run_extract_actions: run the extract_actions function to extract action API supervision from a SIMMC fashion JSON dataset
extract_info_attributes: extract information attributes from a dialogue round datum using NLU annotations
run_main_cli: run the CLI entry point to process multiple JSON files and save extracted API annotations

review_extract_info_attributes: review the extract_info_attributes function that parses NLU intent annotations for attribute extraction
